title: Senators said to hatch idea to toughen Trump's concession on Clarity Act's crypto limits
summary: Insiders say that the bipartisan Senate duo revamping the bill's Trump-approved ethics section have come up with something they hope wins sufficient yes votes.

title: Robinhood slides 4% despite earnings beat as crypto revenue cools
summary: The brokerage reported $100 million revenue from crypto trading, a 38% decline in a year, offset by stronger options, equities and prediction markets activity.

title: As crypto perpetual futures boom, Ethereum’s role is shifting
summary: Rather than competing directly with faster chains, some builders argue Ethereum's strength lies in supporting the layer-2 networks where trading is taking place.

title: Fed holds rates steady, extending pause as markets await Kevin Warsh's policy roadmap
summary: For the first time in several years, markets were somewhat split on whether the U.S. central bank would hike rates.

title: The traditional 9-to-5 banking day is officially dying, says Morgan Stanley execs
summary: Tokenization and 24/7 markets are reshaping finance, making always-on banking a reality.
